Das Programm an Bord Program on Board

Hier findest du das aktuelle Programm und alle öffentlichen Veranstaltungen, die bei uns stattfinden. Konzerte, Clubbings, Perfomances, Open Ship, Barabende, Theater… im Bauch der Stubnitz holen wir dich aus deinem Alltag raus, meist abseits des Mainstreams, es gibt viel zu entdecken: Here you’ll find our current program and all upcoming public events. Concerts, club nights, performances, open ship days, bar evenings, theatre — deep in the belly of the Stubnitz, we offer a break from your everyday routine. Mostly off the beaten track, there’s always something new to discover.

    Do 05.11.2026

    Alex Zhang Hungtai (us), Marta Forsberg (se), Tripolar Ghost (de)

    Upstream: RESONATE

    Concert Series for New Music and Performance

    Resonance deepens, clarifies and strengthens sound. Two resonating waves amplify each other’s trajectory, a symbiosis resulting in shared transcendence of form. ‘To resonate’ also means to strike a personal or emotional chord with someone else. The three artists in this program situate themselves within resonant landscapes, sonic and emotional, in order to amplify what might otherwise lie dormant beneath the noise.
